sql.query: SELECT ct.id,ct.templateName,ct.versionNumber FROM tbl_contract_templates ct WHERE ct.tenantId=:tenantId AND ct.isActive=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY ct.templateName

SELECT w.id,CONCAT(w.workflowName,CASE WHEN w.referenceCode IS NULL OR w.referenceCode='' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(' — ',w.referenceCode) END) workflowLabel FROM tbl_workflows w WHERE w.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=w.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY w.modifiedDate DESC,w.workflowName LIMIT 500
